chapters.title: Contract
chapters.text: Graph Impl owns the context for the system lifetime. Graph Execution is a value type created each update. Jobs must call Set Chunk before per-entity Execute.

chapters.title: GetExecution
chapters.text: Get Execution calls Update Generated and user Update, then returns Graph Execution with Context copied by value, plus Elapsed Time, Delta Time, and Logger.

chapters.title: Execute path
chapters.text: Execute assigns entity context with Graph Id, then Root Value Execute. Execution Header Extensions call Execution Generated unless Type is Default.

chapters.title: IO
chapters.text: Try Set Input finds the sole matching Type Hash then Set Variable into Grove State. Calculate resolves Outputs by Type Hash or Variable Key and evaluates Data Headers.
